verified_facts.text: Accommodations range from vineyard view rooms to two-bedroom suites with kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Call a corner of California wine country your own in exquisite resort accommodations, from vineyard view rooms to luxurious two-bedroom suites with kitchens.

verified_facts.text: The Meritage Resort and Spa opened in 2006 and celebrates its 20th anniversary in 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Throughout 2026, we're celebrating our 20th anniversary by partnering with other Napa Valley icons to give lucky winners unforgettable wine country getaways.

verified_facts.text: Spa Terra is set within a wine cave beneath the vines.

verified_facts.text: Spa Terra offers a vineyard view adult pool.

verified_facts.excerpt: Begin with a guided yoga class and steam room session before your service. Afterward, unwind at our adult pool sanctuary with lunch and a soak in the hot tub.

verified_facts.excerpt: Stretch, sweat and center yourself at wellness classes set in our vineyard, Estate Cave or modern Motion Studio.

verified_facts.text: Spa Terra welcomes guests 18 years or older.
